messages:
maria_cs: Quick sync for NimblePay dedicated bring-up — quota plan, autoscale policy, and load-test window. Target go-live Friday PST. Need owner assignments and a short smoke + 2hr soak.

sam_eng: I can own the load script + ramp profile. Q: what's the steady target vs burst headroom?

maria_cs: Steady 800 QPS, bursts to 1400 for ~2 minutes. Reserved pool = 4 GPUs initially. Want prefix warmup to avoid cold path penalties.

lee_sre: I can own autoscale policy. Proposal: min=1, max=6, step=1, cooldown=120s. Recommend enabling prefix/KV cache and pre-warm hooks.

noah_devops: I'll reserve a load-test slot. Suggest Thur 02:00 UTC (Fri 18:00 PST for customer). Planned command: `locust -f locustfile.py --host https://nimble.example/api -u 200 -r 50 --run-time 2h` — will adjust for target QPS.

arthur_cs: Customer is ok with the window. They asked for a post-test template: include latency SLA checks, error taxonomy, and a cost delta estimate.

alice_pm: Also add a canary/fallback route: route 20% to fallback model v1-quantized during canary. Flag feature gates in the console.

beth_support: I'll prepare a brief feedback form and capture prompt families they use. Will include fields for perceived latency, functional errors, and quality.

deploy-bot: scheduled warmup job created: job-id=8372; eta=30m.

maria_cs: Action items: @sam_eng create load script + ramp profile, @lee_sre push autoscale config into reserved pool, @noah_devops reserve loadslot + run pre-checks, @beth_support prep feedback form. I'll send invite to customer. :thumbsup: 

sam_eng: Uploading ramp profile to /ops/loadprofiles/nimble-pay-800-peak-1400.json

noah_devops: Pre-check checklist running: health endpoints, quota verification, model package present. Health check: `curl -sS https://internal.health/nimble | jq .status` -> "OK"

lee_sre: Autoscale config diff ready:
```
min=1
max=6
metric=fast-path-latency
target=90th<=120ms
cooldown=120s
```
I'll apply after a quick review.

arthur_cs: Note renewal risk: customer mentioned 99.9% latency SLA during procurement. If 90th > 120ms we should flag as risk and discuss options (more reserved GPUs or workload split).

maria_cs: Add to post-test actions: SLA perf check + cost delta estimate for bumping to 6 GPUs.

sam_eng: I'll add telemetry hooks for token counts and KV cache hit rate.

beth_support: Drafting survey now, will share short link in this thread when ready.

alice_pm: Rollback plan: if regressions appear, route 20% traffic to fallback for 30m then full rollback if unresolved.

maria_cs: Can folks join the call during the smoke? @lee_sre @noah_devops

lee_sre: I'll join the call.

noah_devops: Oncall for the slot — confirmed.

deploy-bot: warmup job 8372 completed: primed 3/4 GPUs, avg prime time 7m.

maria_cs: Perfect — keeping thread as the runbook record. Please paste post-test notes here after the soak. Thanks everyone! :heart:
